$conditional_comment: Tests whose add_test() sits behind an early return(), so they vanish from CTest whenever the guard fires. Each needs a reason naming the guard. This list is a defect inventory, not an approved pattern: T1.1 is expected to replace these guards with a declarative registration helper so the skip is visible in the run instead of silent.

$quarantine_schema.$comment: Required shape of every entry in 'quarantine'. A quarantined test must name an owner, an issue, an expiry date, and a reason; an expired entry fails validation. Quarantine is the only sanctioned way to keep a failing test in the tree, because CI does not retry.
$quarantine_schema.reason: why the test cannot simply be fixed now
